children: Greece's jobless rate fell to 7.9% in the second quarter from 10.6% in the first quarter of 2026, data by the country's statistics service ELSTAT showed on Friday.
The jobless rate for women was 10.6% versus 5.7% for men in the second quarter.
About 53.1% of Greece's 379,670 jobless are long-term unemployed, meaning they have been out of work for at least 12 months, the figures showed.
